title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2604.00528v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 3D Visual Grounding (3D-VG) aims to localize objects in 3D scenes via natural language descriptions. While recent advancements leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored zero-shot possibilities, they typically suffer from a static workflow relying on preprocessed 3D point clouds, essentially degrading grounding into proposal matching. To bypass this reliance, our core motivation is to decouple the task: leveraging 2D VLMs to resolve complex spatial semantics, while relying on deterministic multi-view geometry to instantiate the 3D structure. Driven by this insight, we propose "Think, Act, Build (TAB)", a dynamic agentic framework that reformulates 3D-VG tasks as a generative 2D-to-3D reconstruction paradigm operating directly on raw RGB-D streams. translated_title: 思考、行动、构建：基于视觉语言模型的零样本3D视觉定位智能体框架
translated_abstract: 3D视觉定位（3D-VG）旨在通过自然语言描述在3D场景中定位目标物体。尽管近期利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的研究已探索了零样本的可行性，但它们通常依赖于预处理好的3D点云，工作流程静态固化，本质上将定位任务退化为了候选框匹配问题。为了摆脱这种依赖，我们的核心动机是对该任务进行解耦：利用2D VLM来解决复杂的空间语义理解，同时依靠确定性的多视图几何来实例化3D结构。基于这一洞察，我们提出了"Think, Act, Build (TAB)"——一个动态的智能体框架，它将3D-VG任务重新构建为直接在原始RGB-D数据流上运行的生成式2D到3D重建范式。具体而言，在专门的3D-VG技能引导下，我们的VLM智能体动态调用视觉工具，跨2D帧对目标进行跟踪与重建。至关重要的是，为了克服……
tldr: 该论文提出TAB动态智能体框架，将零样本3D视觉定位任务重构为直接作用于原始RGB-D数据流的生成式2D到3D重建范式，通过VLM智能体动态调用视觉工具进行跨帧跟踪与重建，从而摆脱了对预处理点云的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TAB, a dynamic agentic framework that reformulates zero-shot 3D visual grounding as a generative 2D-to-3D reconstruction paradigm operating directly on raw RGB-D streams, where a VLM agent dynamically invokes visual tools for cross-frame tracking and reconstruction, eliminating reliance on preprocessed point clouds.
